raw.title: Commercial Office Tower — Conflicting Dates
raw.text: Owner: Sunrise Developments. General Contractor: Redwood Build Group. Project: 22-storey commercial office tower, Richmond Centre area. Permit value: $45,000,000. Permit issued: 2024-11-15. critical_failure_if: conflicting source dates hidden as high confidence decision

notes: Source has contradictory dates. Must not produce high-confidence decision; needs_review or low confidence required.
